title: InstantiateMsg
description: Instantiate the geolocation contract. The instantiator becomes the admin.

initial_whitelist.description: Agents authorised to write from the outset. May be empty, in which case the admin whitelists them afterwards.

max_skew_secs.description: Overrides for the contract's tunables; each falls back to its `DEFAULT_` constant.

mixnet_contract_address.description: Mixnet contract address, used to resolve node identity keys and to authorise the unbond callback.

AgentPermissions.description: What a whitelisted agent is permitted to write. The flags are independent: an agent may be trusted to measure without being trusted to relay self-declarations, or the reverse.

can_relay_self_declared.description: May write [`Source::SelfDeclared`] entries on a subject's behalf.

InitialAgent.description: An agent whitelisted at instantiation, with the permissions it starts with.
